newsitem.title: USA: Dow surges more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow surges more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average surged more than 50 points Friday, boosted by a report that September wholesale prices rose only moderately.

The Dow rose 50.32 points to 5,971.99 shortly after 11 a.m. EDT after the Labour Department said modest increases in food and energy prices helped to restrain the overall rate of inflation at the wholesale level. The rise activated the New York Stock Exchange's limit on programme trading.
